title: Jeroboam I
summary: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.
description: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 2, "The Kings of Qatna").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Reign: 975-953. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787a
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3031. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3031 = 1002 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 2 "The Kings of Qatna", pp. 13–14
reign.note: Row "Yahad Abum = Jeroboam I" of Table 2 (Kings of Qatna = kings of Israel (CFAH-16)).

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787a
reign.note: Year cell "3713 3031 38". The third printed figure 38 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 22 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
